description: This PHP class extends SugarView to implement an AJAX endpoint for validating if a portal username exists in the contacts database, returning the count of matching records.

classes.name: ContactsViewValidPortalUsername
classes.description: A view class overriding SugarView to handle AJAX requests for validating portal usernames.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the process flow by calling display() method.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the count of contacts with the given portal_name, or 0 if not provided.
